topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Ran into something a little different today. Some sap’s childhood teddy bear turned up at a yard sale. The look on his face when he saw that grizzled, moth-eaten thing—like he’d just dug up a piece of his own past. People hold on to the strangest things, thinking they’ll find them again when they need 'em. Like they can buy back the time that passed them by. He bought it, of course. Felt like I should’ve warned him that some things don’t fit back into your life the way they used to. But what do you say to a man paying to relive a part of his life that’s long gone? Just let him take it, I guess. Some battles you don’t even bother with.
